gallery.source: Hold out rule at South San Francisco station, July 2018
gallery.description: The "hold-out rule" South San Francisco station in July 2018 - the southbound train in the distance has to wait for the northbound train to depart, because the island platform is too narrow for a train to safely pass boarding passengers. At the time this photo was taken, a new wide platform was under construction to the south.
